name: @deploymc/spec-tools
description: Lint and validation for the DeployMC specifications.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:openapi && npm run lint:asyncapi && npm run lint:config && npm run lint:state-machine && npm run check:web-client
scripts.generate:web-client: npm run generate:web-client:rest && npm run generate:web-client:events
scripts.check:web-client: npm run check:web-client:rest && npm run check:web-client:events
scripts.test: node --test test/check-asyncapi.test.cjs test/check-config.test.cjs test/check-state-machine.test.cjs test/generate-web-client.test.cjs test/generate-web-events.test.cjs
